lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for all tested kinds of change ('adoption, new_flow', 'finish, new_screen', 'finish, redesign', 'sign_in, redesign', and 'sign_in, reorder') as each has only 1 test.
No kind of change can be called helpful yet, as no tests have won.
No clear effect was seen for 'adoption, new_flow', 'finish, redesign', and 'sign_in, redesign' changes.
Predictions have been consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measurements across all tests.

candidates.title: story_carousel_layout_switch
candidates.change: Switch the introductory story screen to a interactive carousel layout with visual cards.
candidates.why: Choose path screen has a mean duration of 514s and a 23.8% dropoff, indicating users get stuck or bored on text-heavy story introductions.

story.headline: Choose Your Journey
story.body: Swipe to explore how your desktop pet will interact with your workspace.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of the story screen using a carousel layout.

candidates.score_note: Choose_path has 23.8% dropoff and high mean duration, but no support emails exist and redesigns haven't performed well.

candidates.title: sign_in_data_preservation_headline
candidates.change: Update the sign-in headline and hint to explicitly emphasize account sync and pet state protection.
candidates.why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Preserve Your Pet
sign_in.body: Creating an account backs up your pet memory, customization, and progress.
sign_in.hint: Your pet companions stay safely synced across all logins.

guard.reason: Valid copy update for the sign-in screen emphasizing account synchronization.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 support emails and sign-in dropoff; easy copy change.

candidates.title: pet_personality_quiz_flow
candidates.change: Add a 2-question personality screening screen before pet selection to match users with their ideal pet type.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in onboarding at 60.9% and a median time of 89s.

new_personality_quiz.headline: Find Your Ideal Companion
new_personality_quiz.body: Answer two quick questions so we can suggest the best pet personality for you.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a personality quiz sub-flow screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Adoption has highest dropoff (39.1%), but adding screens is high cost and prior adoption new_flow only gained +0.6%.

candidates.title: waiting_screen_progress_tips
candidates.change: Display setup progress indicators and rotating tip cards while pet asset generation completes on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The waiting/home screen has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing user uncertainty about setup progress.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Companion
waiting.body: Setting up desktop pet graphics and animations. This usually takes under 2 minutes.

components.label: Setup Tips
components.text: Once loaded, your pet will appear directly on your desktop.

guard.reason: Valid update to the waiting screen adding real setup time estimates and tip cards.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high median wait time on home screen indicated by funnel data.

candidates.title: home_intro_desktop_launch_redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home_intro screen with a spotlight layout focused on showing where the pet appears on screen.
candidates.why: Finish step conversion drops to 64.8% and support received multiple complaints that pets do not show up on desktop.

home_intro.headline: Pet Active on Your Display!
home_intro.body: Your desktop pet is now live on your main monitor desktop area.

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a preview cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: upload_photos_quality_tip
candidates.change: Add clear helper tips and format details directly on the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: Support received 3 bug reports stating that custom pet generation fails or looks wrong.

upload_photos.hint: Use bright, well-lit photos with one clearly visible subject for best accuracy.

components.text: Recommended: JPG or PNG files under 10MB.

guard.reason: Valid addition of photo quality hints and guidelines on the photo upload screen.

candidates.score_note: Targets highest dropoff stage with 3 support reports; low effort hint addition.

candidates.title: onboarding_completion_summary_screen
candidates.change: Introduce a completion summary screen with clear action buttons after home_intro.
candidates.why: Finish stage mean time is 5815s with significant dropoff, indicating users lack clarity when onboarding is complete.

new_completion_summary.headline: Adoption Complete!
new_completion_summary.body: Your pet is now active on your desktop. Click and drag to move your companion anywhere.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a new completion summary screen following home_intro.

candidates.score_note: Finish screen has high dropoff, but adding a new screen to finish stage previously yielded -6.5%.

candidates.title: sign_in_troubleshooting_notification
candidates.change: Add a visible sign-in retry button and error delay hint on the sign-in screen.
candidates.why: Support received bug reports that the sign-in screen stalls or fails to appear properly.

sign_in.hint: Taking longer than usual? Verify your connection or try again below.

guard.reason: Valid addition of sign-in troubleshooting notifications and retry options.

candidates.score_note: Supported by bug reports regarding sign-in stalling; moderate UI change.

candidates.title: path_selection_before_story_reorder
candidates.change: Swap the screen order so choose_path comes before the story introduction.
candidates.why: Choose path drops off 23.8% of users; prioritizing path selection immediately increases engagement before story reading.

guard.reason: existing screens must keep their order; only sign_in may move

candidates.title: certificate_naming_incentive
candidates.change: Add an interactive name input styling and celebration badge to the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption has a low completion rate (60.9%) and long duration (median 89s), indicating lack of completion motivation.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Name your pet to complete the adoption papers!

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.components[0]': inputs may only ask for the pet's name

lessons_next: Evidence is still thin for 'finish, new_screen', 'finish, redesign', 'sign_in, redesign', and 'sign_in, reorder' changes, as each has only 1 test.
'adoption, new_flow' changes have shown no clear effect across 2 tests.
No kind of change can be called helpful yet, as no tests have won.
Predictions have been consistently too high compared to noise-corrected measurements across all tests.
